blocks.text: Recombinant DNA technology means cutting, splicing and combining DNA molecules from different sources into a single hybrid molecule, recombinant DNA (rDNA). It also includes introducing the rDNA into a host, such as bacteria, to produce new genetic combinations or particular proteins.

blocks.explanation: A single hybrid DNA molecule made by joining DNA from different sources.

items: rDNA: DNA from different sources combined; put into a host to make new combinations or proteins.
